actions.title: Send tracking info immediately after shipping
actions.why: Buyers who see active tracking updates are less likely to open cases prematurely.

actions.title: Add expected delivery date to shipping confirmation
actions.why: Clear delivery timelines help buyers understand normal delivery windows and reduce panic disputes.

actions.title: Message buyer if tracking shows delay beyond estimate
actions.why: Proactive communication about delays prevents buyers from assuming the package is lost and opening cases.
